instagram.author: goodfood.seattle
instagram.body:
Before flying to Vietnam, I found an app called Moreta Pay that lets you pay like a local without needing a Vietnamese bank account 🇻🇳💸
All I had to do was verify my identity with my passport, then I was able to deposit money directly from my USA bank account into the app. Super easy setup before my trip ✈️
On my first day in Vietnam, I went to a local coffee shop called Rop Reng in Saigon and decided to test it out… and it actually worked 😭✨ I just scanned the QR code and paid instantly like a local.
Honestly, it made traveling so much easier because I didn’t have to carry a lot of cash everywhere. Perfect for cafés, restaurants, and local spots that use QR payments all over Vietnam 👀
